before: A shape's fill and outline are not editable. Concurrent writes to a shape's a:spPr or a:ln have no singleton rule, so two copies of a fill choice or an a:ln both show and save.
after: setShapeFormat writes a shape's fill and outline as ordinary node edits. When two peers write a fill choice, an a:ln, or another once-only a:spPr or a:ln child at once, each replica shows the first live copy, as for other singletons. repairVersion increases to 4, so the format becomes docx-collaboration:1.5.4.1.
reason: The singleton rule decides which conflicting node survives for the same shared state, so it is repair semantics. Every fill write inserts a new fill-choice child: a recolour of an existing fill replaces the old a:solidFill with a new one, and a first fill or a:ln adds one. Two current participants who write a fill or an outline of one shape at once therefore each insert a child, and no write can remove a child the other has not received. A replica with repairVersion 3 lacks the rule, shows both copies, and saves a schema-invalid a:spPr. repairVersion increases to 4, so replicas with repairVersion 3 refuse these rooms before any update applies, and rooms created with repairVersion 3 keep the earlier rules. No stored field or identity changes; the op writes ordinary element and attribute records. The rule is derived on each replica from shared child order, and hidden copies stay in Yjs for undo.
